pinterest.title: How to organize the workshop paint and chemical storage
pinterest.description: Store paint, glue, stain, and solvent so they stay usable and so they never start a fire. Done looks like: Every product in its original labeled container inside a closed metal cabinet, each lid dated in marker, water based paint on one shelf and solvents and thinners on another. Free step-by-step for this zone: https://6s-success.com/zones/workshop-the-finishing-and-chemical-zone.html

instagram.caption:
The wall of half-used paint.
The Finishing and Chemical Zone in the Workshop. Store paint, glue, stain, and solvent so they stay usable and so they never start a fire.

What done looks like:
1. Every product in its original labeled container inside a closed metal cabinet, each lid dated in marker, water based paint on one shelf and solvents and thinners on another
2. Oily rags in a self-closing metal can with the lid down, a drip tray under the solvent shelf, and no aerosol standing on a sunny sill or near a pilot light

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success finishing and chemical zone.
